description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaudawala, Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521001 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations regarding title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, their owners, property boundaries, and registration details, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
